lessons.title: Write a clear message
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
Decide what you want the reader to understand. Begin with a useful subject or opening line, give the necessary context and make your request clear. Reread the message before sending it.

Practise: explain one action from this lesson in your own words. Then complete all three quiz questions to unlock the next lesson.

lessons.title: Use email carefully
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
Check the recipient address before sending. Attach only the intended file and open it yourself to check its contents. Sensitive information should be shared only with the right person through a suitable channel.

Practise: explain one action from this lesson in your own words. Then complete all three quiz questions to unlock the next lesson.

lessons.title: Work in a group chat
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
Keep group messages relevant and easy to follow. Explain context when asking for help and respect people’s response time. Get permission before sharing someone else’s private message or photo.

Practise: explain one action from this lesson in your own words. Then complete all three quiz questions to unlock the next lesson.

lessons.title: Prepare for a call
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
Before an online call, check the time, your connection and the microphone controls. Use headphones if available and mute when background noise would interrupt others. Ask for a text recap if the connection makes the call hard to follow.

Practise: explain one action from this lesson in your own words. Then complete all three quiz questions to unlock the next lesson.

lessons.title: Handle difficult messages
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
Pause before replying to an upsetting message. Keep disagreements about the issue and avoid exposing personal information. If messages become threatening, use the platform’s reporting tools and seek appropriate support.

Practise: explain one action from this lesson in your own words. Then complete all three quiz questions to unlock the next lesson.
